name: Agents
description: The coding agents running right now: what, where, and for how long, scanned when the panel opens; optional sections for several Claude, Codex and Grok accounts and their last-collected usage

commands.description: Agent commands to look for; empty means claude, codex, grok, opencode, aider, goose, crush, gemini, agy, kimi, ori and cursor-agent

paths.description: Show each agent's working directory and pid under its name

accounts.description: Show the Claude, Codex and Grok accounts (haseen agent account list); clicking one makes new sessions start as it

usage.description: Show the usage records omarchy-agent-usage-update last collected (read as files; the panel never asks a provider)

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC target haseen.agents to read the open panel without a keyboard

usageUrl.description: cpa-usage-exporter's OpenMetrics URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9185/metrics); the CLIProxyAPI row is read from it, and nothing is read while it is empty
